title: Unification: Kathmandu taken
detail: Prithvi Narayan Shah of Gorkha takes Kathmandu during Indra Jatra; it becomes the capital of the unified kingdom.

title: Anglo-Nepalese War
detail: Ends with the Treaty of Sugauli (1815-16): Nepal loses Sikkim, Kumaon, Garhwal and much of the Terai.

title: Rana rule begins
detail: After the Kot massacre Jung Bahadur Rana seizes power; hereditary Rana prime ministers rule for 104 years.

title: Western Terai returned
detail: Banke, Bardiya, Kailali and Kanchanpur (the 'Naya Muluk') are restored to Nepal.

title: Sovereignty recognised
detail: Nepal-Britain Treaty of Friendship.

title: Nepal-Bihar earthquake
detail: M ~8.0 on 15 January; thousands killed and much of Kathmandu Valley destroyed.

title: Democracy; Rana rule ends
detail: Nepal opens to the outside world.

title: Everest first climbed
detail: Tenzing Norgay and Edmund Hillary, 29 May.

title: Terai opened to settlement
detail: Malaria control and resettlement schemes (e.g. Rapti valley, Chitwan) bring large-scale clearing of Terai forest for farms.

title: Private forests nationalised
detail: Private Forests Nationalization Act.

title: Panchayat era
detail: Party-less Panchayat system under the king.

title: Land reform
detail: Lands Act sets ceilings on holdings and tenancy rights.

title: First national park
detail: Chitwan National Park established.

title: Sagarmatha National Park
detail: Everest region protected; UNESCO site in 1979.

title: Community forestry begins
detail: Panchayat forest rules let local communities manage forests.

title: Udayapur earthquake
detail: M 6.9 in eastern Nepal, 21 August.

title: Multiparty democracy restored
detail: People's Movement; constitutional monarchy.

title: Forest Act 1993
detail: Community forest user groups get legal rights - a key driver of Nepal's forest recovery.

title: Armed conflict
detail: Maoist insurgency; ends with the Comprehensive Peace Accord.

title: Federal republic
detail: Monarchy abolished on 28 May.

title: Gorkha earthquake
detail: Mw 7.8 on 25 April and Mw 7.3 on 12 May; about 9,000 deaths, tens of thousands of landslides.

title: New constitution
detail: Seven provinces; 753 local governments elected in 2017.

title: Melamchi flood
detail: Debris flood in Sindhupalchok, 15 June.

title: Tiger numbers nearly triple
detail: National survey counts 355 wild tigers (121 in 2010).

title: Jajarkot earthquake
detail: M 5.7 on 3 November in Karnali Province.

title: September floods
detail: Extreme rain on 27-28 September; worst flooding in decades in Kathmandu Valley.

title: M7.1 earthquake
detail: 2025 Southern Tibetan Plateau Earthquake, 07 Jan 2025 (USGS).
